articles.mainIdea: Looking At The Narrative For Cadence Bank After Agreed Sale To Huntington
articles.summary: Simply Wall St.: Looking At The Narrative For Cadence Bank After Agreed Sale To Huntington. Cadence Bank’s fair value estimate has been refreshed to US$44.00 per share, up from US$42.70, with the change closely tied to new assumptions around its all stock sale to Huntington Bancshares. The updated work also nudges the assumed revenue growth rate to about 11.51%, reflecting analyst attention on how the planned combination could support the top line once Cadence sits within Huntington’s broader Texas and Southeast footprint.
